description: High-level syringe dispense action for the 7-head dispense tool. This step exposes calibrated dispense inputs and leaves low-level board execution for a later stage.

inputs.label: Tool Port
inputs.description: Serial device path for the ESP32-controlled syringe board.

inputs.label: Calibration File
inputs.description: Calibration file used to convert dispense amounts into board-specific motor steps.

inputs.label: Dispense Speed
inputs.description: Optional controller speed value. The backend will try to apply it before sending the dispense command.

inputs.label: Head A
inputs.description: Requested dispense amount for syringe head A.

inputs.label: Head B
inputs.description: Requested dispense amount for syringe head B.

inputs.label: Head C
inputs.description: Requested dispense amount for syringe head C.

inputs.label: Head D
inputs.description: Requested dispense amount for syringe head D.

inputs.label: Head E
inputs.description: Requested dispense amount for syringe head E.

inputs.label: Head F
inputs.description: Requested dispense amount for syringe head F.

inputs.label: Head G
inputs.description: Requested dispense amount for syringe head G.

outputs.label: Status
outputs.description: High-level status for the dispense request.

outputs.label: Controller Reply
outputs.description: Placeholder response payload from the future runner.
